contents.text: Worktable
A flat, sturdy platform used to securely hold and position workpieces during CNC machining operations, ensuring stability and precision throughout the cutting process.
Frames
Structural support components that form the main body of the CNC machine, providing rigidity, stability, and precise alignment during machining operations.
CNC_Enclosure_Ventilation
A ventilation system designed to remove heat, dust, fumes, and airborne particles from the CNC machine enclosure, maintaining a safe and controlled working environment.
Base Frames
Structural support components that form the foundation of the CNC machine, providing stability, strength, and secure support for the entire assembly during machining operations.
Power unit
An electrical power supply system that provides the necessary energy to operate the CNC machine’s motors, spindle, control system, and other electrical components.
Spindle
A rotating component that holds and drives the cutting tool at high speeds, enabling precise cutting, drilling, milling, and material removal during CNC machining operations.
Wheel
A rotating circular component used to support movement or guide mechanical parts, enabling smooth motion and positioning within the CNC machine assembly.
Z - Axis
A linear motion system that moves the CNC machine’s tool head or spindle vertically along the Z-axis, enabling precise depth control during cutting, drilling, and machining operations.
Control box
An enclosed housing that contains the CNC machine’s electrical components, controllers, and wiring, allowing users to manage machine operations and control automated machining processes.
Control console
An operator interface equipped with buttons, switches, and a display screen, allowing users to monitor machine status, adjust settings, and control CNC machining operations.
Power connection cable
An electrical cable that connects the CNC machine to an external power source, supplying electricity to the machine’s control system, motors, spindle, and other electrical components.
Support bar
A rigid structural component used to reinforce and support the CNC machine assembly, providing additional stability, alignment, and strength during machining operations.
